subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers grant a proof override for this xAI stale encrypted_content retry fix based on pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative SDK unit coverage, or require an organic after-fix Grok recovery capture before merge?
rationale: The exact failure appears provider-side and not client-inducible on demand, but ClawSweeper's external-PR gate cannot mark mocked unit coverage and pre-fix logs as sufficient after-fix real behavior proof without maintainer intent.

options.title: Grant documented proof override
options.body: Accept the non-inducible provider constraint, apply an explicit proof override, then merge only after rebase and exact-head checks remain green.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future xAI snapshot/key rotation produces redacted gateway logs showing the retry succeeds on this branch.

options.title: Close or replace with broader recovery work
options.body: Pause this narrow fix if maintainers want the broader Responses encrypted-content recovery path to be the canonical landing vehicle instead.

recommendation.title: Grant documented proof override
recommendation.body: Accept the non-inducible provider constraint, apply an explicit proof override, then merge only after rebase and exact-head checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the adjacent merged retry predicate change and is the strongest history signal for the proof-sufficiency decision on the same recovery path.
